function.name: make_dir
function.description: Create a directory inside the configured base directory.

path.description: Relative path of the directory to create.

exist_ok.description: Whether to ignore the error if the directory already exists.

function.name: delete_dir
function.description: Delete a directory from the configured base directory.

path.description: Relative path of the directory to delete.

recursive.description: Whether to delete the directory and all of its contents.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List all items inside a directory.

path.description: Relative path of the directory to inspect.

function.name: rename_dir
function.description: Rename or move a directory within the configured base directory.

path.description: Current relative path of the directory.

new_path.description: New relative path for the directory.

function.name: set_base_dir
function.description: Set the root directory used for all file and directory operations.

abs_path.description: Absolute path that should become the base directory.

function.name: search_dir
function.description: Search for files or folders under a directory by a name pattern.

path.description: Relative directory path to search within.

pattern.description: Optional substring to match against file or folder names.

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a file with optional initial content.

path.description: Relative path of the file to create.

content.description: Initial content to write into the file.

function.name: patch_file
function.description: Replace one chunk of text in an existing file.

path.description: Relative path of the file to patch.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or overwrite the contents of a file.

path.description: Relative path of the file to write.

content.description: Content to write into the file.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full contents of a file.

path.description: Relative path of the file to read.

function.name: rename_file
function.description: Rename or move a file within the configured base directory.

path.description: Current relative path of the file.

new_path.description: New relative path for the file.

function.name: read_metadata
function.description: Read metadata for a file or directory inside the configured base directory.

path.description: Relative path of the file or directory to inspect.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete a file from the configured base directory.

path.description: Relative path of the file to delete.
